from.place: Step 2: naturality of the base-ring maps under morphisms of representative pointed affine etale neighbourhoods.

title: Naturality of the pointed etale neighbourhood base-ring maps
statement: For the chosen small representative category of pointed affine etale neighbourhoods, the maps from the affine base ring R to the coordinate rings obtained from the neighbourhood structure morphisms and GammaSpecIso form a natural transformation.

source.place: Tag 0BSK, naturality in the pointed etale colimit presentation

proof.text: Let N be the inverse representative functor. For f:j⟶k in the opposite category, the over-category equation for N.map f.unop gives Spec.map of the induced affine morphism followed by the structure map at j equal to the structure map at k. Apply Scheme.Hom.appTop, rewrite Hom.comp_appTop, and precompose by GammaSpecIso R.inv; this is exactly the required contravariant global-sections naturality equation.

lean.statement:
theorem strictHenselization_baseRingMap_naturality
    (R : CommRingCat.{u})
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (barY : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec R)
    {j k : (SmallModel.{u} (strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods barY))ᵒᵖ}
    (f : j ⟶ k) :
    (ΓSpecIso R).inv ≫ Scheme.Γ.map
        ((equivSmallModel.{u} (strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods barY)).inverse.obj
          k.unop).1.hom.op =
      ((ΓSpecIso R).inv ≫ Scheme.Γ.map
        ((equivSmallModel.{u} (strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods barY)).inverse.obj
          j.unop).1.hom.op) ≫
        (strictHenselizationAffineDiagram barY).map f
